text_block_list.text:
Hey hey heeey! The winner is ME☆ Here it 
cooomes!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Today was totally perftastic! I had so 
much fun my heart was seriously pounding!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, what should we do for the 
after-party?! A family restaurant? 
Karaoke?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real, for real, zero complaints 
here~~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Pwo-pwo-pwooon☆ Let's get hyped with some 
call-and-response, let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
With your hype, Trainy-P? I'm the 
strongest!! We can party forever!! For 
real though~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So with that said~~~!! Hope we'll be 
together for a long, long time! Nice to 
meetcha~~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?!?! Trai-piyo, isn't your mindset 
super high-level? High-level piyo, am I 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All goody-good-gooood☆ Ready to make this 
race even more hype?
